author: TheStudyofWar
text: ISW assessment: Russian forces continue to rely on crypto-mobilization and high recruitment bonuses to offset heavy losses, avoiding a politically risky second wave of mobilization for now.

author: RALee85
text: Reports of growing manpower shortage along several sectors of the front. Russian milbloggers increasingly discuss the need for additional mobilization to sustain offensive operations.

author: war_mapper
text: Frontline largely static this week. Marginal Russian advances near several settlements; high casualties reported relative to territorial gains.

author: DefMon3
text: Kremlin spokesman again denied mobilization plans, insisting there are enough volunteers. Analysts remain skeptical given recruitment bonus inflation.

author: AnalystOSINT
text: Stalled offensive and personnel shortage are the two structural pressures that could push Moscow toward a new mobilization decree within months.
